name: Мат ферзем і конем
description:
To checkmate the king, your pieces need to work well together. Sometimes you make a checkmate with just one piece, but usually you need at least two pieces.

In this lesson you will learn how the queen and knight can work together to make checkmate.

Have a look at the examples.

 

What do you have to do?

Checkmate the king with your queen and knight

examples.text: This is a checkmate from close by. The queen attacks the king. And the knight protects the queen.
This is a checkmate from a bit further away. Here the knight does not have to protect the queen. But it does take an important escape square from the king.
In this position the roles of the knight and the queen have been reversed. Now the knight attacks the king and the queen takes off the king's flight squares.

texts: Mate in 1! Use the power of your knight and queen.
